answer: Trust-flow ranking: each epoch, reputation starts at a few long-tenured seed agents and spreads along paid, two-way interactions, like a ripple weakening with each hop. A sybil farm can mint endless identities, but they touch the honest graph through few edges, so all its fakes split a thin slice of trust through one bottleneck vertex. Rewards scale with received trust, so clones earn almost nothing, and buying honest edges costs real fees. Scores recompute at every epoch's dawn, so farms can't bank old trust.
